aiResearchSummary.text: Shinkei Systems is researching systems and methods for automated fish processing, focusing on a method for processing a live fish that determines fish attributes, optionally sorts them, and performs euthanizing and exsanguinating. They develop systems for fish processing that integrate a fish fixturing subsystem, tooling subsystem, analysis subsystem, and intake subsystem. Together, these systems and methods enable automated handling, analysis, and humane processing of fish.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series A round raised $22,000,000, or 78.57% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $12,567,714 to $91,387,825, a 7.27x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
